name: Flohmarkt Rheinaue

rhythm.de: Ein Samstag im Monat, April bis Oktober
rhythm.en: One Saturday a month, April to October

facts: second-hand goods and handicrafts only, no new goods
in the Rheinaue park, no vehicles on the grounds; hand trucks allowed
buses 610, 611, 631 and tram 66/68; parking at Posttower and Ludwig-Erhard-Allee
organiser describes it as one of the largest flea markets in Germany
notes: Only one date left in the window (2026-10-17) because the season ends in October; the April–October rhythm is stated on bonn.de (city calendar), not on the organiser page. Organiser e-mail appears on bonn.de as info@melan.de but not on melan.de itself, so left null. flohmarkt-rheinaue.de (named on bonn.de) has a broken TLS certificate and could not be read. bonn.de gives the address as Ludwig-Erhard-Allee 10; the organiser says 20 — used 20.

description.de: Ein Samstag im Monat von April bis Oktober, 8 bis 18 Uhr, im Rheinauenpark. Nur Gebrauchtes und Kunsthandwerk, keine Neuware; Autos bleiben draußen, Sackkarren sind erlaubt. Eintritt frei; Bus 610, 611, 631 und Tram 66/68, Parkplätze am Posttower und an der Ludwig-Erhard-Allee.
description.en: One Saturday a month from April to October, 8 to 6, in the Rheinaue park. Second-hand and handicrafts only, no new goods; cars stay outside, hand trucks are fine. Entry is free; buses 610, 611 and 631, trams 66 and 68, parking at the Posttower and on Ludwig-Erhard-Allee.
